title_footer: Recorded on the live app · sample restaurant data

intro.title: From order to owner's report
intro.subtitle: Waiter  ·  Kitchen  ·  Manager  ·  Cashier  ·  Owner
intro.say: Hishobkr is a restaurant POS for the whole team. Let's follow one day, from the waiter's order to the owner's report.

end.title: Restaurant POS for every role
end.subtitle: Orders · Kitchen · Billing · UPI · Cash drawer · Reports
end.say: Hishobkr. One POS for every role.

clips.heading: Waiter
clips.tagline: Take orders at the table and send them to the kitchen
clips.say: This is Hishobkr for the waiter.

steps.title: Sign in with a PIN
steps.body: Each staff member picks their profile and signs in with a 4-digit PIN.
steps.say: Every staff member has their own profile. Amit picks his name and signs in with his four-digit PIN.

steps.title: Seat the table
steps.body: Tap a free table and set the number of guests. The waiter is assigned automatically.
steps.say: He seats the guests at table five.

steps.title: Take the order
steps.body: Add dishes from the menu. Bestsellers and veg / non-veg are marked on every card.
steps.say: Then he adds dishes from the menu: one Dal Makhani and two Butter Naan.

steps.title: Send it to the kitchen
steps.body: Check the KOT and send it. The kitchen screen gets it straight away.
steps.say: He checks the kitchen ticket and sends it. The kitchen screen gets it right away.

steps.title: Track the order
steps.body: Order details show every item. Waiters take orders; billing stays with the cashier.
steps.say: The order is saved. Waiters take orders; billing stays with the cashier.

steps.title: Live floor plan
steps.body: Table T05 now shows as occupied: ₹340, 3 of 4 seats, just now.
steps.say: Back on the floor plan, table five now shows as occupied.

clips.heading: Kitchen
clips.tagline: Cook from a live ticket screen

steps.title: Kitchen sign-in
steps.body: The chef signs in on the kitchen screen with their own PIN.
steps.say: The chef signs in on the kitchen screen with his own PIN.

steps.title: New tickets arrive
steps.body: Every KOT shows the table, waiter, time and items, newest first.
steps.say: New tickets appear instantly.

steps.title: Start preparing
steps.body: One tap moves a ticket to Preparing so everyone knows it's being cooked.
steps.say: Table five's order is here. One tap, and it moves to Preparing.

steps.title: Mark it ready
steps.body: Marking a ticket ready notifies the waiter on the floor.
steps.say: When it's cooked, the chef marks it ready, and the waiter is notified on the floor.

steps.title: Lock the screen
steps.body: The kitchen sees tickets only — no bills, payments or reports.
steps.say: The kitchen sees tickets only. No bills, no payments.

clips.heading: Manager
clips.tagline: Bills, discounts, cash drawer and staff

steps.title: Manager sign-in
steps.body: Managers sign in with their PIN and land on the POS.
steps.say: Neha, the manager, signs in with her PIN.

steps.title: Every running order
steps.body: See the open orders of every table and waiter at a glance.
steps.say: She sees every running order.

steps.title: Open the bill
steps.body: Table T03: five items, ₹740.
steps.say: She opens table three's bill: five items, seven hundred and forty rupees.

steps.title: Apply a discount
steps.body: A 10% loyalty discount. Large discounts need a manager's approval.
steps.say: She gives a ten percent loyalty discount. Bigger discounts need a manager's approval.

steps.title: Collect payment
steps.body: ₹1,000 in cash — the ₹334 change is worked out for you.
steps.say: The customer pays a thousand in cash, and the change is worked out for her.

steps.title: Receipt
steps.body: Invoice INV-1050 from the server, ready to print, WhatsApp or share as PDF.
steps.say: The receipt has its invoice number from the server, and can be printed, sent on WhatsApp, or shared as a PDF.

steps.title: Shift and cash drawer
steps.body: Expected cash in the drawer updates with every sale: ₹3,532.
steps.say: The shift dashboard shows how much cash should be in the drawer, updated with every sale.

steps.title: Staff management
steps.body: Change roles, reset PINs or deactivate staff from one list.
steps.say: In staff management she can change roles, reset PINs, or deactivate staff.

steps.title: Sections and tables
steps.body: Set up floors, tables and seats for the outlet.
steps.say: And set up the outlet's sections and tables.

clips.heading: Cashier: takeaway & UPI
clips.tagline: Takeaway orders with add-ons, paid by UPI
clips.say: Now the cashier, with a takeaway order.

steps.title: Cashier sign-in
steps.body: The cashier signs in and starts a takeaway order.
steps.say: Rahul, the cashier, starts a takeaway order.

steps.title: Customise the dish
steps.body: Pick the spice level and paid add-ons like Laccha Onions (+₹15).
steps.say: Paneer Tikka can be customised. He picks medium spicy and adds Laccha Onions for fifteen rupees, then adds Butter Chicken.

steps.title: Send the KOT
steps.body: Two items go to the kitchen in one ticket.
steps.say: Both dishes go to the kitchen in a single ticket.

steps.title: Bill with packaging
steps.body: The ₹25 takeaway packaging charge is added automatically: ₹670.
steps.say: For takeaway, the packaging charge is added automatically.

steps.title: Pay by UPI
steps.body: The QR already carries the exact amount and the restaurant's UPI ID.
steps.say: The customer pays by UPI. The QR already has the exact amount.

steps.title: Receipt with add-ons
steps.body: The bill lists every add-on, so the customer sees why it costs more.
steps.say: The receipt lists every add-on, so the bill is clear.

clips.heading: Cashier: cash drawer
clips.tagline: Cash in, cash out and every transaction
clips.say: The cashier also looks after the cash drawer.

steps.title: Next order, or check the drawer
steps.body: After a sale the cashier can start the next order straight away.
steps.say: After a sale, the cashier can start the next order, or check the cash drawer.

steps.title: Shift dashboard
steps.body: Cash, UPI and card sales for the shift, and the cash expected in the drawer.
steps.say: The shift dashboard shows every sale.

steps.title: Cash in
steps.body: Record cash added to the drawer, with a reason, for example change top-up.
steps.say: When cash is added to the drawer, he records it with a reason. Here, five hundred rupees for change.

steps.title: Drawer updated
steps.body: Expected cash goes from ₹2,366 to ₹2,866 straight away.
steps.say: The expected cash in the drawer updates straight away.

steps.title: Find any bill
steps.body: Search transactions and filter by cash, UPI or card.
steps.say: And any bill can be found in transactions, filtered by cash, UPI or card.

steps.title: Owner sign-in
steps.body: The owner signs in as admin.
steps.say: Vikram, the owner, signs in as admin.

steps.title: Today at a glance
steps.body: Sales, orders, average bill, cash in drawer and open KOTs.
steps.say: His home screen shows today's sales, orders, cash in the drawer and open tickets.

steps.title: Everything in one place
steps.body: Shifts, kitchen, transactions, expenses, customers and stock.
steps.say: Every part of the restaurant is one tap away.

steps.title: Reports
steps.body: Today: 6 orders, ₹2,872. Profit, order types and payment modes.
steps.say: Reports show today's six orders, the profit, order types and payment modes.

steps.title: Best sellers and staff
steps.body: Top dishes, categories and sales by each staff member.
steps.say: He sees the best-selling dishes and what each staff member sold, for today, the last seven days, or any dates.

steps.title: Settings
steps.body: Restaurant profile, subscription, GST and charges.
steps.say: In settings he manages the restaurant profile, subscription and taxes.

steps.title: UPI payments
steps.body: Set the UPI ID once and every bill gets its own payment QR.
steps.say: And sets the UPI ID once, for every bill.
